changes.comment: The README names every export: `MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `focusableWithin` and `resolvePlacement` join the inventory. Authoring describes the shared SASS entry and all ten mixins instead of the three that predate it, and states the stylelint rule against hardcoded colours and type. The tokens section introduces the interactive track role. The Spanish README gains the `ThemeProvider` note it was missing. "Upgrading from 0.3.x" states the tighter default density, which no codemod touches. The ThemeProvider README documents `defaultTheme`, `noFlashScript()` and storage failure, and stops saying the no-flash script does not ship. The `storageKey` option of `noFlashScript` said it must match whatever `ThemeProvider` was given, but the provider takes no key and always uses `THEME_STORAGE_KEY`; its documentation now says to leave it unset beside the provider and when setting it is right. `#0F172A` is called carbon everywhere, as the dark theme already did, since `ink` now names the always-dark code surface.
